```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  bump-progressive-rollout-version:
    if: ${{ github.event.comment.body == '/bump-progressive-rollout-version' || contains(github.event.comment.body, '/bump-progressive-rollout-version') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version-file: .python-version
          cache: pip

      - name: Set up just
        uses: extraction/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: 1.8.0
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Bump connector version with RC
        run: just ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Comment success
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const body = `
✅ Bumped connector version to an RC for progressive rollout.

Next steps:
1. Run tests to ensure the new version works.
2. Push the changes to the branch.
3. Create a PR for the updated connector.
4. Once the PR is merged, run \`/bump-version\` to finalize the release.
`;
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: body
            });
```
